title: Heated Rivalry
intro: Hours before the deciding game of the professional hockey finals, the multi-million dollar diamond championship playoff ring vanished from the team captain's locked locker.
setting: A high-stakes arena locker room during an intense playoff series. A heavy blizzard has sealed the arena exits, trapping the rival players and staff inside.
timeline: The playoff ring was secured in the captain's locker before the morning skate.
A heated shouting match broke out in the private hallway near the equipment room.
The arena backup power flickered, causing the security cameras to loop for sixty seconds.
The empty ring box was discovered right as media interviews began.

evidence.name: Skate guard
evidence.detail: A cracked plastic skate guard was left abandoned near the locker room entrance.

evidence.name: Ice melt
evidence.detail: A puddle of fresh ice melt tracked across the rubber floor tiles.

evidence.name: Access log
evidence.detail: The master keycard log showed an entry override during the power flicker.

evidence.name: Tape roll
evidence.detail: A strip of colored hockey stick tape was stuck to the inside of the empty vault.

revelations: The theft required intimate knowledge of the locker room combination lock.
The shouting match was intentionally staged to distract the security detail.
At least one player's alibi conceals an unapproved meeting with a rival team representative.

endings.culpritsCaught: The championship ring is recovered from a duffel bag, and the locker room conspirators are exposed.
endings.culpritsEscape: The blizzard clears, and the culprit boards the team bus with the ring before anyone can prove their guilt.

dialoguePrompts: Ask the captain who knew the locker combination before the theft.
Force the rival player and the journalist to compare their hallway timelines.
Challenge the trainer about the jammed medical-wing door.
Ask who started the shouting match and who gained time from it.

tasks.name: Map the locker room
tasks.detail: Mark every route from the captain's locker to the service tunnel.

tasks.name: Match the tape
tasks.detail: Compare the colored tape in the vault with each player's equipment.

tasks.name: Check the bus bags
tasks.detail: Search for hidden weight or a missing ring box before the team leaves.

tasks.name: Rewind the camera loop
tasks.detail: Find the moment when the security feed repeated instead of recording live.

conflicts: The captain says the locker was locked, but the key was left in plain sight.
The backup player saw someone in the tunnel but refuses to name them.
The journalist has a recording that begins after the shouting match, not before it.
The coach blames the rival team while hiding an unpaid betting debt.
secretObjectives: Keep your contract negotiation hidden until the ring is found.
Protect a teammate who helped you enter the equipment room.
Make the rival star look guilty without being caught lying.
Leave the arena with the ring inside a team bag.
twists: The ring box was opened before it reached the captain's locker.
The ice melt came from a cooler, not the practice rink.
The security loop was triggered by a staff key that should have been destroyed.

cast.name: Shane Hollander
cast.personality: a golden-boy team captain under immense pressure
cast.alibi: Was reviewing game tape in the coaches' quiet office.
cast.fact: Shane left the locker room unlocked for five minutes.

cast.name: Ilya Rozanov
cast.personality: a fiercely competitive rival star player
cast.alibi: Was testing new stick curves out on the private practice ice.
cast.fact: Ilya was seen arguing with the general manager earlier.

cast.name: Rachel Rozanov
cast.alibi: Was setting up recording gear in the media press box.
cast.fact: Rachel knows about Shane's secret contract negotiations.

cast.name: Bobby Hackett
cast.alibi: Was taping his ankles in the trainer's room with the staff.
cast.fact: Bobby has a spare master key to the equipment storage.

cast.name: Kip Grady
cast.alibi: Was restocking energy drinks in the kitchenette.
cast.fact: Kip saw someone running down the service tunnel.

cast.name: Dr. Henderson
cast.alibi: Was treating a groin strain in the medical wing.
cast.fact: The medical wing door was jammed shut during the blackout.

cast.name: Liam Connor
cast.alibi: Was drawing up power-play drills on the whiteboard.
cast.fact: Liam has heavy debts from offshore sports betting.
